segments.text: Lesson 43
segments.translation: 第43课

segments.text: Fully insured
segments.translation: 全额保险

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Who owned the pie dish and why?
segments.translation: 谁拥有这个派盘，为什么？

segments.text: Insurance companies are normally willing to insure anything.
segments.translation: 保险公司通常愿意承保任何东西。

segments.text: Insuring public or private property is a standard practice in most countries in the world.
segments.translation: 在世界上大多数国家，为公共财产或私人财产投保是标准做法。

segments.text: If, however, you were holding an open air garden party or a fete it would be equally possible to insure yourself in the event of bad weather.
segments.translation: 然而，如果你要举办一场露天园游会或义卖会，同样可以投保以防天气恶劣。

segments.text: Needless to say, the bigger the risk an insurance company takes, the higher the premium you will have to pay.
segments.translation: 不用说，保险公司承担的风险越大，你必须支付的保费就越高。

segments.text: It is not uncommon to hear that a shipping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship.
segments.translation: 听到一家航运公司为打捞沉船的费用提出索赔，这并不罕见。

segments.text: But the claim made by a local authority to recover the cost of salvaging a sunken pie dish must surely be unique.
segments.translation: 但一家地方当局为回收打捞一个沉没的派盘的费用而提出的索赔，肯定足独一无二的。

segments.text: Admittedly it was an unusual pie dish, for it was eighteen feet long and six feet wide.
segments.translation: 诚然，那是一个不寻常的派盘，因为它有18英尺长、6英尺宽。

segments.text: It had been purchased by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
segments.translation: 它是由一家地方当局购买的，以便为一年一度的集会烘烤一个巨大的派。

segments.text: The pie committee decided that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal so they insured it for the trip.
segments.translation: 派委员会决定，运输这个盘子的最好办法是通过运河，所以他们为这次旅程投了保。

segments.text: Shortly after it was launched, the pie committee went to a local inn to celebrate.
segments.translation: 在它下水后不久，派委员会去当地一家客栈庆祝。

segments.text: At the same time, a number of teenagers climbed on to the dish and held a little party of their own.
segments.translation: 与此同时，一些青少年爬上盘子，举行了他们自己的一个小聚会。

segments.text: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear, for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
segments.translation: 跳舞被证明超出了盘子所能承受的范围，因为在聚会期间它翻了，并沉入了7英尺深的水中。

segments.text: The pie committee telephoned a local garage owner who arrived in a recovery truck to salvage the pie dish.
segments.translation: 派委员会给当地一个汽车修理厂老板打了电话，他开着一辆抢修车赶来打捞派盘。

segments.text: Shivering in their wet clothes, the teenagers looked on while three men dived repeatedly into the water to locate the dish.
segments.translation: 青少年们穿着湿衣服在打颤中注视着，而3名男子反复潜入水中以确定盘子的位置。

segments.text: They had little difficulty in finding it, but hauling it out of the water proved to be a serious problem.
segments.translation: 他们没怎么费劲就找到了它，但将其从水中拉出来被证明是一个严重的问题。

segments.text: The sides of the dish were so smooth that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it.
segments.translation: 盘子的边缘非常光滑，几乎不可能在不损坏它的情况下将缆索和链条系在边缘上。

segments.text: Eventually chains were fixed to one end of the dish and a powerful winch was put into operation.
segments.translation: 最终，链条被固定在盘子的一端，一台强力绞车开始工作。

segments.text: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
segments.translation: 盘子浮出了水面，并被轻轻地拉向运河岸边。

segments.text: For one agonizing moment, the dish was perched precariously on the bank of the canal, but it suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water.
segments.translation: 在令人焦急的一瞬间，盘子危楼般地停在运河岸上，但它突然失去了平衡，滑回了水中。

segments.text: The men were now obliged to try once more.
segments.translation: 这几个人现在被迫再次尝试。

segments.text: This time they fixed heavy metal clamps to both sides of the dish so that they could fasten the chains.
segments.translation: 这一次，他们在盘子的两边固定了沉重的金属夹，以便系紧链条。

segments.text: The dish now had to be lifted vertically because one edge was resting against the side of the canal.
segments.translation: 现在必须垂直吊起盘子，因为一边正靠着运河的侧壁。

segments.text: The winch was again put into operation and one of the men started up the truck.
segments.translation: 绞车再次开始工作，其中一个男子发动了卡车。

segments.text: Several minutes later, the dish was successfully hauled above the surface of the water.
segments.translation: 几分钟后，盘子成功地被拉出了水面。

segments.text: Water streamed in torrents over its sides with such force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.
segments.translation: 水从盘子的两边汹涌而下，力量之大，以致在运河中激起了一股巨浪。

segments.text: There was a danger that the wave would rebound off the other side of the bank and send the dish plunging into the water again.
segments.translation: 存在这样的危险：巨浪会从对岸反弹回来，使盘子再次掉入水中。

segments.text: By working at tremendous speed, the men managed to get the dish on to dry land before the wave returned.
segments.translation: 由于以极快的速度工作，那些人在巨浪返回之前成功地把盘子弄到了干地上。
